selection: greatest original event timestamp in the second, then latest observed content for equal timestamp
raw_fields: The selected source row is unchanged, including original datetime/id scalar types, missing values and float bit patterns.
subsecond_information: Intentionally reduced at user request; this is not full raw Tick preservation.
empty_second: No invented Tick or carry-forward row. Health evidence and unknown silence remain separately auditable.
open_second: Durable candidate can be replaced by a later source event in the same second.
late_revision: Previous raw content and fingerprints are audited; published archive versions are immutable.
archive_sequence: Export ordinal, with later exports possibly containing revisions for an earlier second.
proof_scope: Selected bytes and source-window overlap; no exchange upstream completeness guarantee.
